verdict: AppDynamics: Choose AppDynamics when Cisco vCPU-priced APM (Premium $33, not $6 infra) is the job — not Datadog host modules by default. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
weaknesses: Easy to confuse $6 infra with $33 Premium
bestFor: Cisco-aligned estates that will model vCPU Premium $33 (not $6 infra-only) as APM TCO
APM buyers comparing AppDynamics to Dynatrace DPS and Datadog modules
Teams already in a Cisco EA who will not self-serve Datadog tiles
notIdealFor: SMBs that need Datadog’s published $15/host Infrastructure Pro tile
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models
Module stacking and consumption overages vs single-SKU floors
Free tiers vs enterprise SSO/audit gates
Landscape-adjacent tools vs primary job-cluster peers on best pages
recommendation: Choose AppDynamics when Cisco vCPU-priced APM (Premium $33, not $6 infra) is the job — not Datadog host modules by default. Compare Datadog for the observability award path; Dynatrace for DPS full-stack; Honeycomb for high-cardinality traces.
editorialNotes: IT Tier-B + ITSM SMB batch. Approved on it-development-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=observability-monitoring. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
